title: Kinds of Plants
description: Grade 2 Science: kinds of plants — trees, shrubs, herbs, climbers and creepers. What plants give us and how to care for them, with interactive sorting games.

topics.title: Big and Small Plants
topics.concept:
Plants come in many shapes and sizes. Some are tall, some are short, some are thin and bendy.

  • 🌳 Very big plants like a mango or banyan tree.
  • 🌿 Medium plants like a rose bush.
  • 🌱 Small plants like grass, tulsi and mint.

Scientists sort plants into groups by their size and their stem.

recap: Plants come in many sizes — big, medium and small.
We sort plants by their size and their stem.
Even tiny grass is a real plant.

wonder.text: A giant banyan tree and a tiny blade of grass are both plants. How can they be so different in size?

qa.q: Why are some plants so tall?
qa.a: Tall plants like trees have a strong, woody stem called a trunk. It holds them up high so their leaves can reach the sunlight.
Yes! Grass is a small, green plant. It grows, needs water and sunlight, and there are thousands of tiny grass plants in a lawn.

topics.title: Trees, Shrubs and Herbs
topics.concept:
We can sort many plants into three groups by their stem:

  • 🌳 Trees — very tall, with one thick, hard, woody trunk (mango, neem, banyan).
  • 🌿 Shrubs — medium, bushy, with many hard stems near the ground (rose, hibiscus).
  • 🌱 Herbs — small and soft with a green, soft stem (tulsi, mint, coriander).
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 330 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="330" height="150" fill="#eefff2"/><text x="55" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🌳</text><text x="55" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Tree</text><text x="165" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🌿</text><text x="165" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Shrub</text><text x="275" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🌱</text><text x="275" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Herb</text><text x="165" y="138" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Trees, shrubs & herbs</text></svg>
recap: Trees → tall, one thick woody trunk.
Shrubs → medium, bushy, many hard stems.
Herbs → small, soft green stem (tulsi, mint).

wonder.text: Press the stem of a mango tree, then a mint plant. One is hard, one is soft. Why?

qa.q: How do I know if a plant is a herb?
qa.a: A herb is small with a soft, green stem you can bend easily. Tulsi, mint and coriander in the kitchen are all herbs.
Big plants with one thick woody trunk are trees. But a bushy plant with many stems, even if quite big, is a shrub — like a rose bush.

topics.title: Climbers and Creepers
topics.concept:
A few plants have very thin, weak stems, so they cannot stand straight. They grow in special ways:

  • 🧗 Climbers — they climb UP a stick, wall or fence for support (money plant, grapevine, beans).
  • 🍉 Creepers — they creep and spread ALONG the ground (pumpkin, watermelon, sweet potato).
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="320" height="150" fill="#f4fff8"/><rect x="10" y="14" width="146" height="120" rx="12" fill="#e4f0ff"/><text x="50" y="74" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🧗</text><text x="83" y="116" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Climber (up)</text><rect x="164" y="14" width="146" height="120" rx="12" fill="#eafbe6"/><text x="204" y="74" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🍉</text><text x="237" y="116" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Creeper (along)</text></svg>
recap: Climbers and creepers have thin, weak stems.
Climbers grow UP a support (money plant, beans).
Creepers spread ALONG the ground (pumpkin, watermelon).

wonder.text: Some plants are too weak to stand up on their own. How do they grow up a wall?

qa.q: Why can't a creeper stand up tall?
qa.a: Its stem is very thin and weak, so it cannot hold itself up. Instead it spreads flat along the ground, where it is safe.

qa.q: How does a climber hold on?
qa.a: Many climbers have tiny curly threads called tendrils that wrap around a stick or fence, just like little hands, and pull the plant up.

topics.title: Plants Give Us So Much
topics.concept:
Plants are kind helpers. They give us many things we use every day:

  • 🍎 Food — fruits, vegetables, grains.
  • 🌬️ Fresh air — plants make the oxygen we breathe.
  • 🪵 Wood — for furniture and paper.
  • 💊 Medicines — many come from plants like tulsi and neem.
  • 🌳 Shade and shelter — and homes for birds.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 360 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="360" height="150" fill="#eefff2"/><text x="45" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🍎</text><text x="45" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Food</text><text x="135" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🌬️</text><text x="135" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Air</text><text x="225" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🪵</text><text x="225" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Wood</text><text x="315" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">💊</text><text x="315" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Medicine</text><text x="180" y="138" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Plants give us so much</text></svg>
recap: Plants give us food, wood, medicine and shade.
Plants make the oxygen we breathe.
More plants means fresher, cleaner air.

wonder.text: Look at your meal, your book and the air you breathe. How many gifts come from plants?

qa.q: How do plants give us air to breathe?
qa.a: When plants make their food, they let out a gas called oxygen — the very air we need to breathe. More plants means cleaner, fresher air!
Yes! For a sore throat, people often use tulsi or honey. Many real medicines are made from plants. Plants help keep us healthy.

topics.title: Caring for Plants
topics.concept:
Because plants help us, we must look after them too:

  • 💧 Water them, but not too much.
  • ☀️ Keep them where they get sunlight.
  • 🌱 Do not pluck leaves or flowers for fun.
  • 🌳 Plant new trees and never harm them.

If everyone plants and cares for trees, our world stays green, cool and full of fresh air.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 330 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="330" height="150" fill="#eefff2"/><text x="55" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">💧</text><text x="55" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Water them</text><text x="165" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">☀️</text><text x="165" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Sunlight</text><text x="275" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🌳</text><text x="275" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Plant trees</text><text x="165" y="138" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Caring for plants</text></svg>
recap: Water plants and give them sunlight.
Do not pluck leaves or flowers for fun.
Plant trees to keep the world green and healthy.

wonder.text: Plants give us so much. What can you do to take care of them?

qa.q: Why should we plant more trees?
qa.a: Trees give shade, clean the air, hold the soil and are homes for birds. Planting trees makes our Earth healthier for everyone.

qa.q: Is it bad to pluck flowers?
qa.a: Plucking flowers and leaves for fun hurts the plant and means fewer flowers for everyone. It is kinder to enjoy them on the plant.

questions.q: A tree has a stem called a…
questions.explanation: Trees have one thick, hard, woody trunk.

questions.q: Which of these is a herb?
questions.explanation: Mint is a small plant with a soft green stem — a herb.

questions.q: A money plant that grows UP a wall is a…
questions.explanation: Climbers grow up a support like a wall or stick.

questions.q: Plants give us the gas we breathe, called…
questions.explanation: Plants make oxygen — the fresh air we breathe.
A rose is a bushy, medium plant with many hard stems — a shrub.

questions.q: Which is the BEST way to care for plants?
questions.explanation: Plants need water and sunlight to stay healthy.

questions.q: A pumpkin plant spreads along the ground. It is a…
questions.explanation: Creepers spread along the ground — like pumpkin and watermelon.

questions.q: How does a climber hold onto a stick?
questions.explanation: Climbers use tiny curly tendrils that wrap around a support.

questions.q: Which group has the SOFTEST stems?
questions.explanation: Herbs have small, soft, green stems you can bend easily.

questions.q: Why does cutting many trees make the air less fresh?
options: Trees make the oxygen we breathe
questions.explanation: Trees make oxygen, so fewer trees means less fresh air.

questions.q: Which set lists a tree, a shrub and a herb in that order?
questions.explanation: Mango is a tree, rose is a shrub, and mint is a herb.
